title: Traveler Profile
description: Durable travel preferences that persist across trips, per docs/itinerary-data-model.md §6. Schema/template only — real filled-in profiles are never committed to this repo (docs/HANDOFF.md §10, design spec §4). Trip-specific data (dates, companions on this trip, hotel, must-see list) belongs on the Trip entity in itinerary.schema.json, not here. All fields are optional: a profile is built up incrementally, never invented (docs/HANDOFF.md §6.2).

pace.description: Durable default. A Trip may override this for a specific occasion.

interests.description: Interest topics with relative weight, not a fixed category list — avoid overfitting one traveler's interests onto all travelers.

notes.description: Freeform durable preferences not covered by a structured field above.

tolerance.description: How the traveler feels about this trade-off, not a hard yes/no.
